prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: 地铁各线路首末班车时刻表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 9 rows. Row headers: yes.
Measured content facts (text px at 15px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "线路" · longest unbreakable unit 17px · widest one-line content 48px
  col 2: header "工作日首班" · longest unbreakable unit 41px · widest one-line content 77px
  col 3: header "工作日末班" · longest unbreakable unit 41px · widest one-line content 77px
  col 4: header "周末首班" · longest unbreakable unit 42px · widest one-line content 62px
  col 5: header "周末末班" · longest unbreakable unit 41px · widest one-line content 62px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 360px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The table, including its 1px outer border, must be at most 360px wide (column widths sum to at most 359px); no horizontal scrolling. A table exactly 360px wide fits.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Several designers worked independently on this table. You see their final layouts, anonymised as Layout P, Layout Q, in that order after the overview: Layout P, Layout Q.
Measured facts:
Layout P: column widths [69, 81, 81, 64, 64] px · table 360×351 px · row heights [60, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers on >1 line: 4/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 0 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)
Layout Q: column widths [69, 69, 69, 63, 63] px · table 334×351 px · row heights [60, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers on >1 line: 4/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 0 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)

Compare them side by side. For each layout name its strengths, its faults and the spatial logic behind it (how it distributes space and why). Do not just pick a winner: you may combine the strengths of several layouts, propose something new, or overturn all of them. Propose up to 3 new designs that you expect to be better than every layout shown; if you believe one shown layout cannot be improved, say so in "best" and propose fewer or none.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"analysis":[{"layout":"name","strengths":"","faults":"","spatial_logic":""}],"insights":"what the comparison teaches about this table","best":["names of the best layout(s) so far"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[int px],"idea":"what it combines or changes, and why"}]}

log.raw: {"analysis":[{"layout":"P","strengths":"全部线路名和时刻完整可见；表格正好适应视口，表头按“工作日／周末”和“首班／末班”分行，便于理解。","faults":"工作日列明显宽于周末列，但四列中的时刻格式相同；周末时刻靠近右侧边框，列间疏密不均。","spatial_logic":"线路列保留完整线路名的空间，剩余宽度主要分给标题较长的工作日列，充分使用视口。"},{"layout":"Q","strengths":"全部内容完整可见，表头分行有意义；四个时刻列较为紧凑，行内信息集中，便于逐行查阅。","faults":"右侧留出26px空白，而时刻列仍较紧；工作日列比周末列稍宽，同类数据的留白不完全一致。","spatial_logic":"线路列维持与P相同的宽度，收窄四个时刻列，以更紧凑的表格保留视口右侧空白。"}],"insights":"两种布局的行高和表头分行相同，增加列宽并未减少换行。线路名需要足够宽度保持完整；四个时刻列承担相同的查阅和比较任务，可以更均衡地分享剩余空间。","best":["Q"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[69,73,73,72,72],"idea":"保留能容纳最长线路名的首列，将剩余宽度近乎均分给四个时刻列。预计保持现有表头分行和行高，同时让时刻列的留白更均衡、更宽松。"}]}
